conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: One complete online publisher text inspected for eligibility; no local PDF acquired. Five unresolved records retain pending decisions. Source and inspected extent are recorded; paper content is not redistributed.
conventions.c1: The unchanged 2020–2026 window applies. Official proceedings or explicitly identified preprint/journal versions are inspected; final-version equivalence is not assumed.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.

records.title: Robust Unrolled Network for Lensless Imaging with Enhanced Resistance to Model Mismatch and Noise
records.version: Published Optics Express 32(17), 30267–30283 (2024), DOI 10.1364/OE.531694; publisher-supplied full text on ResearchGate.
records.read_extent: Main text §§1–6, including Eqs. 7–10, 23 and 32, acquisition description, experiments and Table 1; data-availability statement. Derivations and numerical results not independently reproduced.
records.technical: MN-FISTA-Net augments image recovery with a structured mismatch nuisance variable, mixed regularization and learned denoising. Experiments use three lensless datasets and real objects. Operator posteriors, probability calibration and selective rejection are not demonstrated.
records.applicability: O: nuisance estimation, not verified physical-PSF recovery. S: qualitative display-to-object transfer, not held-out-operator transfer. U: optical degradation plus noise. W: PSNR/LPIPS do not establish hallucination testing.
quality_followups: Reconcile conflicting acquisition counts and sensor specifications between §3 and Fig. 3 before replication; underlying data are available only by request.
